Gladiator Oggy
episodes.summary: Oggy and Olivia go to the Coliseum to watch a gladiator combat. The roaches filch Oggy's popcorn but when he goes after them he ends up being enlisted as a gladiator!

episodes.title: Shift that Chariot, Oggy!
episodes.summary: When Oggy sees Olivia set off to Rome on Bob's chariot, he's miserable. How can he compete? He doesn't know how to drive those things! Jack gives him chariot driving lessons, which become a nightmare when the roaches get involved.

episodes.title: Oggy's Special Spa
episodes.summary: Oggy finds a great job working in the Roman Baths. Today, a celebrity is expected: Julius Caesar! Unfortunately, the cockroaches want to use the luxury spa too. Oggy freaks out: if Caesar sees those roaches, he can say goodbye to his new job!

episodes.title: RodeOggy
episodes.summary: Jack wants to participate in a rodeo contest organized by Buffalo Bill. Joey also wants the first prize. He is also registering. Jack then leaves the contest and asks Oggy to replace him. Who will win? Joey or Oggy?

episodes.summary: While playing with cockroaches, Piya disturbs Oggy's house. When Piya understands that this weighs on Oggy, she becomes even more manic than him... Oggy and Piya will have to compose together to find the right balance and live in harmony.
